question:
Choose the appropriate synonym of the given word.
Erroneous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fallacious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Erroneous"** means something that is incorrect, based on false information or mistaken beliefs. (त्रुटिपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The report contained several erroneous statements that needed to be corrected.
 
 
• **"Fallacious" **refers to something based on a mistaken belief or an invalid argument. It is often used to describe misleading reasoning or logic. (भ्रमपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The idea that success comes without hard work is completely fallacious.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'erroneous' **is **'fallacious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fallacious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vital **(महत्वपूर्ण): Something that is essential or of utmost importance.
 
 
• **Example:** Drinking water is vital for maintaining good health.
 
 
• **Right **(सही): Something that is correct or morally good.
 
 
• **Example:** It is always right to tell the truth, no matter the consequences.
 
 
• **Accurate** (सटीक): Free from error; exact and correct in all details.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather forecast was accurate, predicting rain for the entire day.
